blocker_schema.acceptance_to_close: non-empty list of evidence-backed closure checks; preservation-only acceptance is invalid
blocker_schema.blocked_false_proofs: non-empty list naming proof types that must not be accepted as buildability
blocker_schema.blocked_surfaces: non-empty list of product/runtime surfaces disabled by the blocker
blocker_schema.blocker_family: one of the required blocker families in this matrix
blocker_schema.owner_docs: non-empty exact repo paths to current owner docs; candidate owners are invalid
blocker_schema.required_evidence: non-empty list of concrete behavioral, runtime, security, persistence, command-wiring, or clean-room proof

captured_plan_complete_buildable_ladder.rule: Captured source, exact tokens, source-lineage rows, audit findings, or ledger atoms are not plan-complete and are not buildable.
Plan-complete means canonical docs, PlanUnits, indexes, source lineage, and governance checks are coherent; it is not implementation buildability.
Buildability requires concrete schemas, command wiring, security boundaries, behavioral acceptance, currentness, persistence, provider behavior, and executable clean-room lifecycle evidence.

families.required_proof: Every runtime contract has concrete payload, validator, receipt, retry, rollback, and executable proof routing.
Durable state, idempotency, transactional outbox, replay, restart, and receipt persistence are proven by fixtures.
Approve And Build consumes the buildability report and shows blocker families plus exact owner docs while disabled.
Actor identity, permission, credential, trust, source-control, destructive-action, and policy boundaries reject unsafe paths.
PNC-019 executable lifecycle certification proves Approve And Build through PlanCompile, Executor intake, activation, projection, testing, restart/cancel, and negative cases.
Provider/account/model/auth stream behavior, degraded paths, cancellation, retries, quota, and evidence capture are exercised.
Acceptance names observable behavior, state transitions, events, failures, and evidence; preservation-only acceptance is excluded.
Executable-order, dependency, owner, placeholder, payload, and graph integrity are proven beyond index existence.
Every buildability responsibility has exact current owner docs; source-lineage and compatibility docs are excluded as current authority.
CAS/currentness rejects stale but valid PlanningRun, pack, index, testing, project context, provider, and source-control inputs.
Executable clean-room positive and adversarial lifecycle harness passes with receipts; static scenario lists remain targets only.

scripts/pm-implementation-readiness.py.handling: Register in Plans/Spec_Lock.json during governance seal; do not treat validator success as buildability.

Plans/.implementation_readiness/readines.handling: Human-updated readiness input; open rows block Approve And Build, while closed and accepted_risk rows remain historical closure evidence.
Human-updated schema and proof contract; register in Plans/Spec_Lock.json during governance seal.

Plans/.implementation_readiness/buildabi.handling: Regenerate with python3 scripts/pm-implementation-readiness.py generate; do not hand-edit; register the current generated report in Plans/Spec_Lock.json during governance seal.
